comment: The S3 keys a delivery names, with the delivery role that must (reads, writes) or must not (never) reach each. infra/test/delivery.test.ts matches every row against the synthesized role policies of both stages; crates/orchestrator/tests/delivery_source_keys.rs pins every key to the function that builds it. Keys are shown for one sample run. Regenerate nothing by hand without changing the producer test.

reads.producer: store::s3::turn_prefix + bundle: a writer's turn bundle, a one-task run's held head (sourceBundleUri) and every taskBundles entry
orchestrator::verifier::merge_bundle_key: the merged run head (sourceBundleUri) and a fast-forwarded copy
store::s3::repo_bundle_key: the held head of a run that blocked before any merge

harness_protocol::direct::s3::snapshot_bundle_key: agentd's last snapshot, the held head of a direct run whose session ended without a final bundle (plan_delivery HeadSource::Snapshot, sourceBundleUri); live run 01M4ZX2QEMB4JFCA411Q5169AY (A8 run 3) was refused this read
store::s3::verified_bundle_key: written by the validator, read by the validator, the packager and the PR push
orchestrator::verifier::report_key: finalGatesUri of the clean verifier session on the run head
orchestrator::gate_run::report_key: a taskGateUris entry of the RED turn
orchestrator::gate_run::report_key: a taskGateUris entry of a GREEN or repair turn
orchestrator::verifier::report_key: a taskGateUris entry of the task's clean verification
orchestrator::verifier::report_key_with (recheck 1): the first re-run of a clean verification after a hidden-set revision; the goal step records it with the others
orchestrator::verifier::report_key_with (recheck 12): re-run numbers have no upper bound
store::s3::evidence_prefix + name: every object the packager lists under evidence/ goes into the zip
harness_protocol::research::s3::manifest_key: the third-party copy rule (delivery::third_party) reads the manifest of every item the run stored
harness_protocol::research::s3::body_key: the same rule reads the stored page or archive the manifest names

never.producer: store::s3::hidden_manifest_key: hidden tests are the verifier role's alone
orchestrator::verifier::report_key (collect-hidden): its report names the hidden tests
store::s3::request_key: the run request is not delivery input
harness_protocol::direct::s3::snapshot_bundle_key: only the validator reads a snapshot; the packager and the PR push read the verified bundle it writes
harness_protocol::research::s3::audit_key: the route's audit objects are not read by a delivery role
harness_protocol::research::s3::search_key: the snippets shown to Cline are not read by a delivery role
only the bundle validator applies the copy rule, so only it reads a stored item
